# sigma_tenant (Data Source)

Retrieves a Sigma tenant organization by ID. This resource uses a Sigma Beta API and may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_tenant" "example" {
  id = "tenant-organization-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tenant organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Member ID that created the tenant.
- `parent_organization_id` (String) Parent organization ID.
- `shared_at` (String) Share timestamp, when applicable.
- `tenant_api_url` (String) Tenant organization API base URL.
- `tenant_cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider hosting the tenant.
- `tenant_organization_name` (String) Display name of the tenant organization.
- `tenant_organization_slug` (String) URL identifier for the tenant organization.
- `tenant_region` (String) Region hosting the tenant.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Member ID that last updated the tenant.
